scope: Source-bound combined native and registered-clock proof for consumed host drafts; selected passive timeline and capture controls remain separate observations.

environment.networkHarness: Each measured command runs in a fresh ordinary-UID user/network namespace, loopback only and no routes, with setup capabilities removed before Bun and existing test preload retained.
environment.resources: GNU time measures full command inside shared lock; CPU includes descendant work and RSS is reported as maximum resident set size, not aggregate browser memory. Shared host load uncontrolled.

setup: capture addresses, routes and uid_map; assert only loopback and no routes
harness.preload: Every command uses bun run test and its existing preload. Browser commands set BRAIN_REQUIRE_CHROME=1 and retain mandatory package/client builds.
harness.serialization: Every measured command acquires the same exclusive benchmark lock; timing starts inside it.
observerLimits: Synchronous setup timing and afterAll logging add overhead. Baseline wait timing surrounds the original await without replacing its promise.
Passive browser wrappers preserve actual handles and original fetch/body promises. Added promise reactions affect microtask overhead; settlement is not application-consumer completion.
The successful corrected timeline writes its complete file only after original assertions. A synchronous bundle copy adds setup I/O.
Native document reload discarded the prior page buffer; final documents cover the entire original observation window. Parent HTTP observations span reload.

priorBoundClearEvidence.basis: Actual production bound-clearing fault recreates content after the native default 800 ms save and fails the original final host-absence assertion; the retained exact lower case fails on any additional PUT. Native/client/fixture/lockfile and lower harness identities are recorded above. These historical mutations were not rerun for this source-identical attribution.

incompleteCapture.reason: Captured JSON ends within the first browser page before its final-window data; no complete page trace is recoverable.

transportProbe.limit: One observed transport command only; no emitter attribution beyond captured output path.
transportProbe.interpretation: The same wrapper/output route captured valid byte-identical console and file JSON at all three sizes. This did not reproduce the first capture truncation and does not identify a fixed limit or emitter cause.

interpretation: No draft publication, local-work status publication, observed IndexedDB transaction or visibility/online/focus/selection event occurred in the captured final window on either current document.
Other activity continued: SDK liveness registrations, a transient turn-status interval and non-draft-class GET/body completions. Endpoint and consumer identity for the latter were not retained.
The sending client registered and fired actual zero-delay owed work before the window. Cross-process clock alignment is approximate; these snapshots do not establish global quiescence.
Early IndexedDB transactions completed on both pages; their exact service ownership remains unattributed. The account-bound local-work conclusion is source inference, not a captured accountKey value.

sourceCorrection.basis: This fixture mounts BrainUiProvider and ChatPage without ConnectionGate/LoginScreen/useVpnStatus account binding. connection.accountKey starts null; local-work onAccount/changed guards leave account-bound writes inactive. AUTH_MODE=none alone is not the reason.
sourceCorrection.limit: No direct runtime accountKey value was captured. Real IndexedDB remains present. Account-bound storage behavior in other fixtures is not covered by this inference.

faultPath.interpretation: The actual 800 ms registration (id 16) was cancelled by refresh; the actual zero-delay callback (id 17) fired before the extra PUT under another id. Earlier id 11 is an ordinary setup save, not the mutation delay.

proofResponsibilities.guarantee: Both live clients, default saving before send, exact positive saved-reference acceptance, real backend prompt receipt and host draft consumption, all original composer/host/one-send assertions.
Sending-client retired zero/save work, own stale GET fencing, second clean-client stale GET and later deletion refresh, no additional PUT under any id over save and backoff horizons.
Actual failed-request retry registrations and cancellation remain in existing cases; merely advancing backoff-sized horizons here is not a forced retry callback claim.

limits: One matched native pair on an uncontrolled shared host; wall-time reduction is not a whole-CI or CPU improvement.
Peak RSS is the GNU time process-tree maximum, not summed browser memory.
No universal minimum delay or global browser drain is established. The combined proof is specific to this host-draft fixture and its no-new-input observation.
Historical mutation evidence and local controls do not establish hosted qualification of a later integrated tree.
